facts.fact: Historiccentre coverage includes Cathedral, Cabañas, Degollado and Plaza Tapatía.
The municipality lists Juárez station on Line1 as a way to the historiccentre.
The Expiatorio is grouped with Colonia Americana, apart from the centre cluster.
